faq.a: The Summit at 15466 North Bluff Road was built 1995, per the MLS® strata building record.
The Summit is 7 storeys with 42 apartments.

faq.q: What amenities does The Summit have?
faq.a: A recreation centre, library, billiard room, garden, bike storage and secured underground parking.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.
